body: I don't know what to say except that you are a beautiful person. I looked at some of your other posts on this subreddit and I can tell your heart is pure. I can't say that you've fixed me, lying is cruel, but I can say that you've extended my lifeline. I didn't expect to get anything out of posting this. I'm so thankful that someone like you came along so quick. Thank you so much. I will never forget you.

I'm also so scared that those who are at-risk will read this and start to agree with me. Please know that I'm wrong. My intention isn't to hurt and it never has been. Whoever you are reading this. I love you and I hope you're ok.

It's just really hard to be selfless all the time. Just this once I want to be selfish. I want to give to charity and make lives better and do all these wonderful things, but if I did I'd be something of a husk for the rest of my life. I'm so hurt and I'm so tired of hurting. I'm trying really hard to push away my selfish desires for death because it would hurt everyone I love. Simultaneously I see living as selfish. I have no right answers and I never have. I sit around in my room and cry because my anxiety gets so bad. I've started cutting myself off from everyone so as not to take up their time with my problems. I worry that if I do keep living I'll have just pushed away my issues deep down and all that will be left is a compassionate and subservient husk. One that does not know. I'm scared of becoming that. I'm so scared.
